questions.question: What boosting algorithm builds trees sequentially?
questions.explanation: Gradient Boosting iteratively adds trees that correct previous errors.

questions.question: What metric represents the square root of MSE?
questions.explanation: RMSE provides error measurement in the same units as the target variable.

questions.question: What SVM parameter controls the margin-error tradeoff?
questions.explanation: The C parameter balances maximizing margin and minimizing errors.

questions.question: What technique transforms features for non-linear SVM?
questions.explanation: The kernel trick maps data to higher dimensions without explicit computation.

questions.question: What metric measures absolute average prediction error?
questions.explanation: MAE calculates the average magnitude of errors without squaring.

questions.question: What prevents decision trees from growing too deep?
questions.explanation: Pruning removes branches to prevent overfitting.

questions.question: What XGBoost feature handles missing values automatically?
questions.explanation: XGBoost learns optimal directions for missing values during training.

questions.question: What regression metric represents explained variance proportion?
questions.explanation: R-squared indicates how well predictions match actual values.

questions.question: What distance metric does KNN commonly use?
questions.explanation: Euclidean distance measures straight-line distance in feature space.

questions.question: What ensemble method trains models on bootstrap samples?
questions.explanation: Bagging reduces variance by averaging predictions from resampled datasets.

questions.question: What impurity measure do classification trees commonly use besides entropy?
questions.explanation: Gini impurity measures the probability of misclassifying a random sample at a node.

questions.question: What strategy trains one binary classifier for every pair of classes in multiclass problems?
questions.explanation: One-vs-One builds classifiers for each class pair and uses voting for the final prediction.

questions.question: What pioneering boosting algorithm is short for Adaptive Boosting?
questions.explanation: AdaBoost reweights misclassified samples so later weak learners focus on harder cases.

questions.question: What regression method fits smooth curves using weighted local fits around each point?
questions.explanation: LOESS fits simple models to localized subsets, producing a flexible smooth curve.

questions.question: What method plots error rates against k values to help choose the optimal k in KNN?
questions.explanation: The elbow method looks for the point where increasing k stops significantly reducing error.
